notes: Lead the headline, standfirst, lede and tweet with the Wine Trader: the San Marino-flagged chemical tanker was struck by drones about 13 nautical miles southeast of Sulina on 15 October, seven of her 12 crew are missing and five were rescued, with the search continuing, per Reuters, gCaptain and The Maritime Executive. Call her a chemical or product tanker, not a general cargo ship, and keep the seven missing in the headline and lede.

Keep the two tankers apart: the Yara J is the second one, struck inside Romanian waters late on Wednesday 14 October, and her crew put the fire out themselves with no one hurt before she headed to Constanta, per Splash247 and The Maritime Executive, so give her no casualties and leave the seven missing crew to the Wine Trader.

For the GFS Pride, report that the Singapore-flagged container ship sank after being struck by a projectile on 13 October with all 21 crew safely evacuated and no injuries, per Singapore's Maritime and Port Authority, and drop the three injured.
